title: Team member closeout: Eclipsed Masking Shade (952c10) — G1b DELIVERED, PR #161 merged 793cb3c1; claim closed; zero retained
body:

- Surprise or changed understanding (for the Director's consolidation, per closeout discipline — implementers do not write .agent/memory in this team shape): (1) the work-evidence cross-check before claiming caught a LIVE predecessor mid-turn via worktree file mtimes — a cheap, decisive liveness probe; instance of ping-before-escalate done right, worked cleanly with the 19:15Z hold exchange. (2) My team-start's "tree presumed not compiling" reading was stale within minutes (predecessor completed the sweep mid-window) — broadcast-then-verify beat verify-then-broadcast here; the predecessor's correction was friction-free because the claim was framed as a presumption.
